setBonuses.description: (4 items) Adds 1 Weapon and Spell Damage

title: Solstice Giant Crocodile Skull
flavorText: Among the Argonians of Solstice, the crocodile was seen as a guardian of the Unmaker, Sithis. This skull belonged to an enormous beast, likely reared by worshippers of the Dread Father to guard one of his temples.
name: Solstice Giant Crocodile Skull

title: Solstice Giant Crocodile Ribs
flavorText: Among the Argonians of Solstice, the crocodile was seen as a guardian of the Unmaker, Sithis.  Ribs like these have been found in ancient ceremony sites dedicated to the Death-Dancer sect, a void-dwelling tradition dating back centuries.
name: Solstice Giant Crocodile Ribs

title: Solstice Giant Crocodile Tail
flavorText: Among the Argonians of Solstice, the crocodile was seen as a guardian of the Unmaker, Sithis. Enormous beasts like this once acted as mounts for Stone-Nest assassins in their ancient conflict with Coldharbour.
name: Solstice Giant Crocodile Tail

title: Large Solstice Bismuth Tower
flavorText: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. These ornamental towers once marked future locations for Xanmeers or temple support buildings, a discipline now lost to the artisans of today.
name: Large Solstice Bismuth Tower

title: Geometric Stone-Nest Totem
flavorText: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. These simple totems were once wayfinders to sacred structures across Solstice. They have been moved so many times that it's impossible tell what they were originally pointing to.
name: Geometric Stone-Nest Totem

title: Stone-Nest Totem, Iguana
flavorText: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. A representation of a simple lizard may seem ironic in a culture of lizard-folk, but these beasts were seen as sacred animals in the distant past.
name: Stone-Nest Totem, Iguana

title: Stone-Nest Totem, Behemoth
flavorText: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. Most likely an ancient representation of the dangerous Vahath Behemoth, a guardian beast created in the days of myth and legend.
name: Stone-Nest Totem, Behemoth

title: Stone-Nest Totem, Massive Skull
flavorText: An artifact of the incredible Stone-Nest Argonian culture. The skull of Sithis wears many shapes and has been worked into stone in a hundred different ways.
name: Stone-Nest Totem, Massive Skull

title: Mad God's Dancing Shoes
enchantDescription: Adds 351 Maximum Stamina.
flavorText: "Why do I need a reason for everything? Mortals always need a reason to do things. For example: people like to think that light chases away the shadows! I prefer to think that without a few lights, there'd be no shadows to enjoy." — Sheogorath
name: Mad God's Dancing Shoes

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) While in combat, roll dodging creates a random effect. This effect can occur once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Effects:

-Create a cheese wheel under an enemy within 15 meters that deals 6814 Magic damage to enemies in 3 meters after |cffffff1|r second.
-Deal 5453 Physical damage to enemies facing you after |cffffff1.5|r seconds.
-Deal 7200 Magic damage to the nearest enemy.
-Gain Major Expedition for |cffffff4.5|r seconds.
-Restore 1172 Stamina.
-Reduce the cost of your next non-Ultimate ability by 14%.
-Gain |cffffff7|r Ultimate.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge and Sprint by 6%.

title: Rakkhat's Voidmantle
enchantDescription: Adds 351 Maximum Stamina.
flavorText:
All is ruin. All is sorrow. The Moons have forsaken you, and doom is upon you. 

You will drown in shadow and blood!
name: Rakkhat's Voidmantle

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) Increases your damage done with non-Ultimate Heavy Attacks and decreases your damage done with Light Attacks by 50% each.

Dealing damage with a Light Attack restores 431 Magicka or Stamina, depending on your equipped weapon type. This resource restore is treated as a Heavy Attack resource restore for bonuses and penalties. Your Heavy Attacks no longer restore resources.

traitDescription: Increases Mundus Stone effects by 9.1%.

title: Monomyth Reforged
enchantDescription: Reduce Health, Magicka, and Stamina cost of abilities by |cffffff133|r. This effect does not work with abilities that drain their cost multiple times over their activation.
flavorText:
"In Mundus, conflict and disparity are what bring change, and change is the most sacred of the Eleven Forces. Change is the force without focus or origin."
— Oegnithr, Taheritae, Order of PSJJJJ
name: Monomyth Reforged

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) While in combat and on your Primary Weapon gain Major Force, Minor Berserk, and Minor Vulnerability.

While in combat and on your Secondary Weapon gain Major Protection, Minor Vitality, and Minor Timidity.

traitDescription: Increases Maximum Magicka by |cffffff439|r, Maximum Stamina by |cffffff439|r, and Maximum Health by |cffffff482|r.

title: Solstice Reward Coffer
flavorText: A bounty given to adventurers for aiding the people of Solstice with problems on the isle of Solstice.
name: Solstice Reward Coffer

title: Solstice Reward Coffer
flavorText: A bounty given to adventurers for aiding the people of Solstice with problems on the isle of Solstice.
name: Solstice Reward Coffer

title: Tiny Model Sloop
flavorText: A detailed miniature that depicts a sailing ship of Sunport.
name: Tiny Model Sloop

title: Sea Glass Collection
flavorText: An assortment of sea-weathered glass beads and shards in a small wooden box.
name: Sea Glass Collection

title: Izta-Ahuak Shell Fetish
flavorText: The handiwork of Solstice's Tide-Born Argonians, this talisman is made from seashells and fishbone.
name: Izta-Ahuak Shell Fetish

title: Ivory Three Queens Icon
flavorText: Carved from mammoth ivory, this icon depicts Meridia, Azura, and Nocturnal as three figurines with joined hands.
name: Ivory Three Queens Icon

title: Corelanya Lace Doily
flavorText: An intricate example of High Elf lacework, likely tatted by a young noble to practice patient craftsmanship.
name: Corelanya Lace Doily

title: Portrait Sketch of Regent Vinutilmo
flavorText: A flawed planning sketch for a formal portrait. Regent Vinutilmo is shown seated on a throne with a sword across his lap.
name: Portrait Sketch of Regent Vinutilmo

title: Wicker Sithis Effigy
flavorText: An Argonian idol in the form of a twisting serpent devouring its own tail.
name: Wicker Sithis Effigy

title: Lucky Conch Shell
flavorText: A rare blue shell found along the coast of Solstice. It is threaded with a leather cord for easy carrying.
name: Lucky Conch Shell

title: Pewter Rose Chalice
flavorText: A fine cup, engraved with the rose emblem of the Sanguine's cult.
name: Pewter Rose Chalice

title: Petrified Wood Molag Bal Fetish
flavorText: An ancient figurine depicting Stone-Nest Argonian warriors fighting Molag Bal.
name: Petrified Wood Molag Bal Fetish

title: Rune-Etched Gilded Skull
flavorText: Etched with necromantic runes, this human skull has been carefully preserved in gilt gold. A disquieting piece.
name: Rune-Etched Gilded Skull

title: Blood Rose Ruby Pin
flavorText: A delicate gold brooch featuring a ruby carved in the shape of Sanguine's blood rose.
name: Blood Rose Ruby Pin

title: Coral Comb
flavorText: This small comb is carved from a piece of polished coral and fitted with wooden teeth.
name: Coral Comb

title: Solstice Bath Salts
flavorText: A pouch of bathing salts produced from evaporation ponds on the shores of Solstice.
name: Solstice Bath Salts

title: Floral Hand Soap
flavorText: Made from blossoms found in the tropical forests of western Solstice.
name: Floral Hand Soap

title: Pearl-handled Mirror
flavorText: A beautiful hand mirror with a handle finished in mother-of-pearl. A soft sea breeze seems to tease the holder's hair.
name: Pearl-handled Mirror

title: Obsidian Scraping-Stone
flavorText: A hand-sized stone with one sharpened edge to help an Argonian shed those last few stubborn scales.
name: Obsidian Scraping-Stone

title: Silver Blossom Hair Clip
flavorText: Crafted in the shape of a tropical flower, this delicate hair clip demonstrates the artistry of High Elf workmanship.
name: Silver Blossom Hair Clip

title: Stone-Nest Ruined Scroll
flavorText: Made with bamboo paper, this ancient text still holds together but is illegible in its current form.
name: Stone-Nest Ruined Scroll

title: Cone Shell Paperweight
flavorText: This handsome shell is mottled with patches of blue and brown. It is filled with heavy resin.
name: Cone Shell Paperweight

title: Sunport Captain's Seal
flavorText: A bronze stamp embossed with a warship's heraldry. Used for official correspondence.
name: Sunport Captain's Seal

title: Corelanya Calligraphy Set
flavorText: A beautiful set of parchments, inks, and quills in an antique wooden case marked with the Corelanya emblem.
name: Corelanya Calligraphy Set

title: Royal-Gall Ink
flavorText: Brewed from galls found on rare tropical hardwoods, royal-gall ink has a lustrous blue hue.
name: Royal-Gall Ink

title: Stone-Nest Scroll Weights
flavorText: A pair of ancient Argonian paperweights carved from onyx.
name: Stone-Nest Scroll Weights

title: Dancing Faun Napkin Rings
flavorText: A fine set of napkin rings made from pewter, featuring images of frolicking fauns.
name: Dancing Faun Napkin Rings

title: Sunport Spice Shakers
flavorText: A pair of painted ceramic shakers, fired in the shape of Sunport's Corelanya palace.
name: Sunport Spice Shakers

title: Slaughterfish-tooth Knife
flavorText: A wooden table knife set with slaughterfish teeth. It doesn't cut as well as you might think.
name: Slaughterfish-tooth Knife

title: Coral-carved Ladle
flavorText: A beautiful ladle made of wood and coral, carved to resemble a sea beast frolicking in the surf.
name: Coral-carved Ladle

title: Silver-and-Pearl Seafood Fork
flavorText: A High Elf heirloom forged in the shape of a sea serpent, its jaws agape.
name: Silver-and-Pearl Seafood Fork

title: Frog-Metal Crab-Cracker
flavorText: A rather plain shell-cracker made of exotic alloy. It doesn't work better than an ordinary crab-cracker, but it floats.
name: Frog-Metal Crab-Cracker

title: Wolf-Claw Fetish
flavorText: Five lupine claws threaded together with a leather cord, cast-off claws kept for good luck.
name: Wolf-Claw Fetish

title: Packmaster's Whistle
flavorText: Carved from a Wood Elf's fingerbone, this whistle produces a high-pitched tone only wolves and other beasts can hear.
name: Packmaster's Whistle

title: Wolfsbane Sachet
flavorText: A small pouch of dried wolfsbane, said to be carried by werewolves hoping to resist transformation.
name: Wolfsbane Sachet

title: Bottled Moonlight
flavorText: A crystal vial etched with a wolf's head and filled with a mysterious liquid that shimmers with a pale light.
name: Bottled Moonlight

title: Gold-Capped Werewolf Fang
flavorText: An oversized tooth from the jaws of a massive wolf, capped with gold and bearing the sigil of Hircine.
name: Gold-Capped Werewolf Fang

title: Silver Arrowhead Collection
flavorText: A handsome wooden box holding half a dozen stained silver arrowheads. The grim jest of a werewolf who survived.
name: Silver Arrowhead Collection

title: Haefriding Lodestone
flavorText: A simple compass of Nord design, dating back to the voyages of Haefrid and her fleet.
name: Haefriding Lodestone

title: Tide-Born Minnow Trap
flavorText: A small wooden water wheel designed to be left in a tidepool. You can catch live minnows for bait. Or snacks.
name: Tide-Born Minnow Trap

title: Sunport Coffee Press
flavorText: A small copper pot with a plunger to force hot water through the grounds.
name: Sunport Coffee Press

title: Corelanya Song Spinner
flavorText: A lovingly crafted music-maker made of delicate tropical woods. You spin the upper section to play a jaunty tune.
name: Corelanya Song Spinner

title: Stone-Nest Sundial
flavorText: An Argonian piece made of polished stones cunningly fitted together. An attached gnomon slides to account for the time of year.
name: Stone-Nest Sundial

title: Necromancer's Monocular
flavorText: A lens worn over one eye, embossed with the symbol of the worm cult. For necromancers performing fine anatomical stitching.
name: Necromancer's Monocular

title: Moon-Sugar Grinder
flavorText: A hand-cranked metal grinder used to process dried moon-sugar cane.
name: Moon-Sugar Grinder

title: Skooma-Flavored Incense
flavorText: Often used to cover up more odious odors, it smells of skooma without all of the side-effects.
name: Skooma-Flavored Incense

title: Portable Skooma Scales
flavorText: A set of scales, pans, and weights used to measure out skooma. It can be folded up neatly for traveling.
name: Portable Skooma Scales

title: False-bottomed Scroll Case
flavorText: The cap of this case is an ornate design in gold. The opposite end unscrews to reveal a hidden compartment.
name: False-bottomed Scroll Case

title: Skooma Sobriety Chit
flavorText: Meant to celebrate the bearer's sobriety from Skooma use for a full year. Issued by a church of Arkay in Sentinel.
name: Skooma Sobriety Chit

title: Skooma Pipe Belt Buckle
flavorText: This large belt buckle is emblazoned with the smiling face of a Skooma Cat, and has a hidden smoking pipe attached to the back.
name: Skooma Pipe Belt Buckle

title: Nord Ship Pull-Toy
flavorText: A wooden toy carved to resemble one of the original ships of Haefrid's fleet. It moves on hidden rollers beneath the hull.
name: Nord Ship Pull-Toy

title: Rolling Hoop
flavorText: Made from a metal barrel hoop, children roll these through the streets with a short wooden pole.
name: Rolling Hoop

title: Stone-Nest Sphere Puzzle
flavorText: A three-dimensional puzzle in the shape of a sphere. Once one stony piece is removed, it completely falls apart in your hands.
name: Stone-Nest Sphere Puzzle

title: Bag of Krona Stones
flavorText: Small interlocking construction blocks as if for a very small xanmeer. Made from light-weight pumice, these blocks are dyed in a variety of colors.
name: Bag of Krona Stones

title: High Elf Alphabet Blocks
flavorText: Each scribed block uses sacred numerology and calligraphy to highlight one of the many runes of High Elvish.
name: High Elf Alphabet Blocks

title: Dipping Terror Bird
flavorText: Made of clear glass filled with dark-colored liquid, this simple toy will repeatedly dip its beak into a mug of water.
name: Dipping Terror Bird

title: Child's Breakfast Bowl
flavorText: A heavy duty ceramic bowl for a small person's morning meal. It has a picture of a sloth painted at the bottom.
name: Child's Breakfast Bowl

title: Sunport Drink Coasters
flavorText: A set of six glass coasters displaying sites across Solstice. Used to keep perspiring drinks from ruining a table's finish.
name: Sunport Drink Coasters

title: Handcrafted Butter Dish
flavorText: A bright yellow rectangular ceramic dish. It features a lid with a feathered guar as a handle on the top.
name: Handcrafted Butter Dish

title: Three Queens Washbasin
flavorText: This wide metal basin has images of the Three Queens — Meridia, Azura, and Nocturnal — worked into the handles.
name: Three Queens Washbasin

title: Black Iron Sandwich Press
flavorText: A long-handled device with two plates on a hinge. The word flavor, in Nord runes, is set into the interior of both plates.
name: Black Iron Sandwich Press

title: Nord Thundermug
flavorText: This large earthenware chamber pot is made of glazed ceramic, featuring a snuggly fitting lid with a cork seal.
name: Nord Thundermug

title: Chalk Stick Set
flavorText: A set of six colored chalk sticks used by guards to mark dangerous buildings and the position of dead bodies.
name: Chalk Stick Set

title: Solstice Guard Whistle
flavorText: A two-tone metal whistle. Law enforcement in Solstice have a code for what the various whistles mean.
name: Solstice Guard Whistle

title: Guard Barricade Ribbons
flavorText: Long spools of red ribbon laced with metal twine, used to keep miscreants out of restricted areas.
name: Guard Barricade Ribbons

title: Mage Manacles
flavorText: Heavy iron bracers connected at the wrists, with leather finger caps. Intended to impede complex hand motions by the prisoner.
name: Mage Manacles

title: Infraction Book
flavorText: A leather-bound guard's notebook. The handwriting is impossible to read, but most of the infractions are for malingering.
name: Infraction Book

title: Rabble Rousting Rod
flavorText: This thick, short-handled baton is used to encourage drunks found sleeping in doorways to go home.
name: Rabble Rousting Rod

title: Solstice Horse Blanket
flavorText: A large, quilted blanket with a daffodil-colored fringe.
name: Solstice Horse Blanket

title: Well-Worn Wool Shears
flavorText: The handles of these two-handed shears are smooth from use, but the edges of the blades are still shiny and sharp.
name: Well-Worn Wool Shears

title: Black Slate Blinders
flavorText: A pair of thin stone rectangles, mounted on either side of the horse's head to keep them from being distracted.
name: Black Slate Blinders

title: Corelanya Clan Caparison
flavorText: A heavy cloth worn over a horse's barding during jousts and ceremonies, this one is emblazoned with the Corelanya coat of arms.
name: Corelanya Clan Caparison

title: Nord Honing Stone Set
flavorText: These smoothly polished whetstones are perfect for sharpening large blades like great swords and great axes.
name: Nord Honing Stone Set

title: Hooked Feather Farmer's Tool
flavorText: A simple iron tool shaped like a large beak. Used to trim molting feathers on massive beasts.
name: Hooked Feather Farmer's Tool

title: Shore-Wading Mudders
flavorText: Strapped onto boots, these attachments have lateral wings that distribute the weight and make it easier to cross tidal pools.
name: Shore-Wading Mudders

title: Ornaug Bone Mirror
flavorText: Carved of ornaug bones, the frame of this glass mirror shows hunters on the Abecean Sea pursuing the creatures in small boats.
name: Ornaug Bone Mirror

title: Nord Beard Beads
flavorText: A small pouch containing a variety of beard adornments made of copper, silver, and ivory. Some are cracked or tarnished.
name: Nord Beard Beads

title: False Orc Tusks
flavorText: A set of dental bridgework used to replace tusks that have been lost through age or combat.
name: False Orc Tusks

title: Iron Bed Warmer
flavorText: A well-polished ember pan with a long handle, all the better to slip beneath a mattress or sleeping bag.
name: Iron Bed Warmer

title: Decorative Boot Brush
flavorText: This sturdy brush is carved to look like a hedgehog with bristles out the back. Used to scrape the mud off of boot soles.
name: Decorative Boot Brush

title: Vampiric Dentures
flavorText: A set of false teeth with elaborate fangs.
name: Vampiric Dentures

title: Pot of Flesh-Toned Makeup
flavorText: A small tin containing flesh-toned makeup in various hues, allowing various kinds of undead to move more easily in cities.
name: Pot of Flesh-Toned Makeup

title: Ancient Noble's Medallion
flavorText: An army award from an ancient, long-forgotten kingdom. So worn from use and age the name is no longer legible.
name: Ancient Noble's Medallion

title: Gilded Bleeding Knives
flavorText: A golden set of thin-bladed lancets used for bloodletting when other methods would be more obvious.
name: Gilded Bleeding Knives

title: Blood-Stained List of Victims
flavorText: Just the heading of this list can be read — "Prey". The rest is coated in dried blood and illegible.
name: Blood-Stained List of Victims

title: Empty Valente Vineyard Bottle
flavorText: The Valente Vineyards near Skingrad are said to make an excellent vintage, but this empty bottle smells of blood.
name: Empty Valente Vineyard Bottle

title: Kinlady Iniel's Intaglio
flavorText: This carved amethyst depicts Kinlady Iniel of the Corelanya Clan, who died at Ash'abah Pass fighting the sons of King Xawhan.
name: Kinlady Iniel's Intaglio

title: Guar Feather Fake Eyelashes
flavorText: Harvested from a beautiful feathered guar, complete with beauty paste to keep them on.
name: Guar Feather Fake Eyelashes

title: Shelltide Tooth Polish
flavorText: A blend of coconut oil, sea salt, and ground pumice stone brings a nice shine to any smile.
name: Shelltide Tooth Polish

title: Bloodsand Ritual Face Paint Jar
flavorText: Sand mixed with tainted blood makes for long-lasting paint. Perfect for complex necromancy.
name: Bloodsand Ritual Face Paint Jar

title: Salamander Egg Sun Paste
flavorText: Solstice Argonians spread this across their scales to retain moisture while sunning on the beach.
name: Salamander Egg Sun Paste

title: Decay-Cover Perfume
flavorText: A blend of strong floral odors intended to keep you smelling fresh even when working with a large pile of bodies.
name: Decay-Cover Perfume

title: Adder Bone Hairclip
flavorText: Made from the wings and frills of sea adders, a fashion statement that will still let you wade into the fray.
name: Adder Bone Hairclip

title: Seawater Pendant
flavorText: Sailors who venerate Kynareth keepsake some seawater from their first successful voyage, a memento and lucky charm.
name: Seawater Pendant

title: Saltlinen Death Shroud
flavorText: A light cloth made from seaside plants, used to cover the head of the recently deceased during funereal services.
name: Saltlinen Death Shroud

title: Rune-carved Whalebone Worry Stone
flavorText: A well-worn worry stone made with whalebone and covered in runes of Stendarr.
name: Rune-carved Whalebone Worry Stone

title: Sithis Prayer Card
flavorText: The front side depicts the threatening visage of Sithis. A prayer to the Void is scrawled on the back.
name: Sithis Prayer Card

title: Arkay Defensive Censer
flavorText: Smoke from burning incense in this gold bowl wards off angry spirits and wandering undead.
name: Arkay Defensive Censer

title: Osteomancy Bones
flavorText: A small bag of bones. By spilling them out they are said to make a pattern, perfect for divinations.
name: Osteomancy Bones

title: Sunport Spiced Rum Jug
flavorText: A round, tan glass jug. Used to contain the most popular liquor on Solstice.
name: Sunport Spiced Rum Jug

title: Palm Wood Teacup
flavorText: A spotted pattern marks the textured wood of this teacup. The handle feels smooth from years of use.
name: Palm Wood Teacup

title: Sanguine's Favor Survival Flask
flavorText: Etched with Sanguine's rose. An inscription encourages owners to carry a little party with them wherever they go.
name: Sanguine's Favor Survival Flask

title: Black Chalice of the Dread Father
flavorText: Made of deep black glass, this chalice has complex icons and runes venerating Sithis etched around the base.
name: Black Chalice of the Dread Father

title: Tiger Leather Water Pouch
flavorText: This sturdy, water-tight pouch bears striped fur on its exterior. A dark brown wooden stopper plugs the opening.
name: Tiger Leather Water Pouch

title: Chukka-Sei Stoneware Tumbler
flavorText: Stone-Nest Argonians craft these to use in celebrations after a successful coming-of-age ceremony.
name: Chukka-Sei Stoneware Tumbler

title: Painted Stone Weight
flavorText: Brightly patterned stones to hold down fishing nets. Tide-Born Argonians take pride in the artistry of these weights.
name: Painted Stone Weight

title: Bone-handled Fishing Shears
flavorText: The serrated iron blades of these shears can make quick work of any fish bones or crab shells.
name: Bone-handled Fishing Shears

title: Mysterious Fish Whistle
flavorText: Merchants in Sunport claim this tin whistle can attract even the most reticent fish.
name: Mysterious Fish Whistle

title: Strangler Spine Spearhead
flavorText: When dried and stored properly, a strangler plant's spikes make excellent spears for hunting fish.
name: Strangler Spine Spearhead

title: Bright Plumage Lure
flavorText: The unique coloration of jungle bird plumage makes for excellent lures that attract even stubborn fish.
name: Bright Plumage Lure

title: Wriggling Chum Satchel
flavorText: A stitched leather bag filled with animated guts from unknown creatures. Necromantic magic keeps the chum wriggling.
name: Wriggling Chum Satchel

title: Tiger-gut Lute String
flavorText: Coiled string meant for a traditional High Elf lute. Local musicians love the warm tones of Solstice tigers.
name: Tiger-gut Lute String

title: Stone Marimba Bar
flavorText: Argonian musicians carefully cut and polish stone bars to improve resonance and amplify the instrument's unique sound.
name: Stone Marimba Bar

title: Children's Slide Whistle
flavorText: A modest wooden whistle with a handled slide at the end. Stags, hares, and foxes from Nord folklore are painted on it.
name: Children's Slide Whistle

title: Ritual Brass Singing Bowl
flavorText: Embossed with icons of Molag Bal. Meant to be played while Worm Cultists loudly chant during ritual summonings.
name: Ritual Brass Singing Bowl

title: Maormer Hand Drum
flavorText: Sea Elf sailors play this to keep a steady rowing rhythm when coming to shore. Also fun during drunken parties.
name: Maormer Hand Drum

title: Island Flower Vessel Flute
flavorText: This glass flute resembles a curved animal horn. Small, multi-colored flowers are embedded inside the glass along its ridge.
name: Island Flower Vessel Flute

title: Steel Drawplate
flavorText: Corelanya blacksmiths use this drawplate to make chainmail for their guards. Scorch marks around the holes say its well-used.
name: Steel Drawplate

title: Worn Maormer Chisel
flavorText: A simple metal chisel with a sea serpent's image on the handle. The edge has gone dull from years of over use.
name: Worn Maormer Chisel

title: Bristleback Brush
flavorText: Nords on Solstice insist that only bristleback hair will do for cleaning anvils and blacksmith tools.
name: Bristleback Brush

title: Rotting Servant Brand
flavorText: A twisted iron brand of Daedric characters, used to mark the personal undead of a powerful Worm Cultist.
name: Rotting Servant Brand

title: Serrated Dagger Mold
flavorText: Used to rapidly produce small daggers for Tide-Born hunters. The serrated edge helps crack through crab or Hadolid shell.
name: Serrated Dagger Mold

title: Blacksmith's Magnifying Glass
flavorText: Made from beach glass and used to find small imperfections in new blades.
name: Blacksmith's Magnifying Glass

title: Cultist Noise Complaints
flavorText: A letter between two Worm Cultists, with the writer complaining about the amount of screaming during designated sleeping hours.
name: Cultist Noise Complaints

title: Daedra-Spotting Pamphlet
flavorText: A list of many Daedra types with checkboxes so people can track the kinds observed.
name: Daedra-Spotting Pamphlet

title: Soggy Sloth Care Manual
flavorText: Instructions and guidelines for keeping sloths healthy and happy. Still soaked from its time in the ocean.
name: Soggy Sloth Care Manual

title: Three Queens Hymnal
flavorText: A black, pocket-sized collection of songs expressing devotion to Meridia, Azura, and Nocturnal.
name: Three Queens Hymnal

title: Corelanya Heritage Tree
flavorText: A meticulous chart tracking the relationships of individuals within the island-bound clan.
name: Corelanya Heritage Tree

title: Crew Advertisement
flavorText: A broadsheet encouraging the bored and impoverished to join a pirate crew. Badly spelled and fails to mention where to sign up.
name: Crew Advertisement

title: Washed Up Pirate's Doll
flavorText: Drenched in water and now dressed in seaweed. A pirate's treasure gone overboard.
name: Washed Up Pirate's Doll

title: Torn-Up Smiling Doll
flavorText: Mangled and torn to shreds by violence, but they still couldn't tear away this doll's smile.
name: Torn-Up Smiling Doll

title: Frond Doll
flavorText: Made from palm tree leaves and twigs by kids bored of playing in the sand.
name: Frond Doll

title: Annotated Jephre Effigy
flavorText: Procured from Summerset by merchants from the Red Sails. Sold to Sunport Elves curious about the old ways of the archipelago.
name: Annotated Jephre Effigy

title: Seaweed Sloth
flavorText: Someone's taken the time to gather seaweed, stone, and sticks to make this innovative dried-weed doll.
name: Seaweed Sloth

title: Meridia's Marvel Doll
flavorText: Laced with shining Solstice gemstones that glow a golden hue at night.
name: Meridia's Marvel Doll

title: Worn-Out Guar-feather Shawl
flavorText: A tattered shawl that's seen enough love from the beach and the sun.
name: Worn-Out Guar-feather Shawl

title: Shriveled, Shrunk Picnic Cloth
flavorText: Pieces of fish bones are stuck to this picnic cloth. What the tide giveth it also takes back, as the Tide-Born saying goes.
name: Shriveled, Shrunk Picnic Cloth

title: College of Sea and Sword Picnic Blanket
flavorText: Weaved at its center is an insignia of the College of Swords and Sails.
name: College of Sea and Sword Picnic Blanket

title: Pirate's Skull and Bones Tablecloth
flavorText: What was once used to terrify other ships is now a tablecloth to break bread. Make mead, not war!
name: Pirate's Skull and Bones Tablecloth

title: Shell-Tide Scale Cloth
flavorText: A fine piece of cloth made for Argonians to clean between their scales.
name: Shell-Tide Scale Cloth

title: Tide-Born Beach Pillow
flavorText: Knitted and designed to endure even harsh sunlight, perfect for a nap on the beach.
name: Tide-Born Beach Pillow

title: Watery Sandcharm
flavorText: A perpetually wet cloth enchanted to dispel granules of sand when rubbed on one's attire. Rubbing on skin may cause a rash.
name: Watery Sandcharm

title: Sea's Song Throw Net
flavorText: An enchanted net with grains of salt clinging to its fibers. Attracts and sticks to fish when thrown into shallow water.
name: Sea's Song Throw Net

title: Sweet Tongue Mouth Tack
flavorText: For when you can't bear the taste of salty water while swimming. Ingesting may damage taste buds. Keep under tongue.
name: Sweet Tongue Mouth Tack

title: Enchanted Seed Bag
flavorText: A mildly enchanted cloth bag that keeps seeds placed inside perfectly fresh. Great for gardeners and snackers alike.
name: Enchanted Seed Bag

title: Alaxon Verses
flavorText: Verses of meditation, each word inscribed with runes to attune and focus an Elven mind.
name: Alaxon Verses

title: Stone Whisperer Oil
flavorText: A vial of tree oil brewed with curative spell incantations, used to care for relics made of stone.
name: Stone Whisperer Oil

title: Corelanyan Sun Cream
flavorText: Designed to protect a High Elf's sensitive skin under the harsh Solstice sun.
name: Corelanyan Sun Cream

title: Pickled Fish in a Jar
flavorText: Frequently sold by Argonian merchants, a Solstice delicacy! Supposedly restores one's vitality after a long swim.
name: Pickled Fish in a Jar

title: Sticky Healing Sap
flavorText: Many Argonians used Solstice's flora for healing after being driven to the west side of the island. But their hearts still hurt.
name: Sticky Healing Sap

title: Stone-Nest Claw Ointment
flavorText: Soothes calluses formed at the base of the claws when engaging in long hours of stonework.
name: Stone-Nest Claw Ointment

title: Daedric Cure-All Remedy
flavorText: Sold in seedy corners of Sunport, this swill purports to use parts from real Daedra to cure your ills.
name: Daedric Cure-All Remedy

title: Alaxon Courage
flavorText: Supposedly a swig of this mysterious liquid results in a ten-fold increase in focus on your goals.
name: Alaxon Courage

title: Eyepatched Eyeball Bottle
flavorText: An eyeball in an eyepatch in a bottle. Some pirate's idea of a sick joke, no doubt.
name: Eyepatched Eyeball Bottle

title: Sea Shell Full of Gold Teeth
flavorText: Someone decided to store their unique collection in this natural container.
name: Sea Shell Full of Gold Teeth

title: Preserved Fish-head Scepter
flavorText: A desiccated fish head stuck on a large bone to make an impromptu scepter. And it barely even smells.
name: Preserved Fish-head Scepter

title: Preserved Stone-Nest Tails
flavorText: Two lizard tails fitted into a stone casing. They both arch to form a heart, signifying their love.
name: Preserved Stone-Nest Tails

title: Bloody Argonian Egg
flavorText: Bloodstains paint the inside of this now-hollow Argonian egg.
name: Bloody Argonian Egg

title: Bloody Fightin' Mead Mug
flavorText: This sturdy mug is splashed with stains colored red, yellow, purple, and gold. It's clearly seen a lot.
name: Bloody Fightin' Mead Mug

title: Tidecaller's Conch
flavorText: Sold by Argonian peddlers on the beach to naive folks that have extra gold under their tail. A charm, if anything.
name: Tidecaller's Conch

title: Mini Mud Figurine
flavorText: Before their hands are stone-ready, some Stone-Nest children work with mud to satisfy their eager minds.
name: Mini Mud Figurine

title: Adoring Effigy
flavorText: Carved by a traveler to commemorate an encounter with a strange man somewhere on mainland Tamriel.
name: Adoring Effigy

title: Xanmeer Sculpture
flavorText: A miniature depiction of the ancient xanmeer structures on Solstice.
name: Xanmeer Sculpture

title: Three-Faced Effigy
flavorText: An effigy combining Meridia, Azura, and Nocturnal into a single three-faced being. Unnerving.
name: Three-Faced Effigy

title: Masterpiece Molag Bal Idol
flavorText: The impeccable craftsmanship clearly showcases the carver's devotion to either their craft or their ghastly Daedric Prince.
name: Masterpiece Molag Bal Idol

title: Aged Jar of Salted Meat
flavorText: A memento from the far north to remind a Nord of where they used to live.
name: Aged Jar of Salted Meat

title: Magecrafted Boat Model
flavorText: A single piece of stone shaped by mystical means to resemble an intricately detailed sailing vessel. You can see the expressions on the tiny little crew.
name: Magecrafted Boat Model

title: Parchment of Tattoo Scrawls
flavorText: The idle doodles of a master tattoo artist. Signed with the initials J.W..
name: Parchment of Tattoo Scrawls

title: Sparkling Argonian Egg
flavorText: An Argonian's birth-egg, preserved and decorate with gems and seashells. It glimmers under the sun.
name: Sparkling Argonian Egg

title: Khajiiti Sand Comb
flavorText: A fine-toothed comb for sun-worshipping Khajiiti beachgoers.
name: Khajiiti Sand Comb

title: Roll of Sea Serpent Skin
flavorText: Likely purchased from a passing Sea Elf trader, this sturdy material can be used in a variety of ways.
name: Roll of Sea Serpent Skin

title: Pristine Corelanyan Sail
flavorText: While it looks brand-new, some say this caught the wind aboard the first ship that brought High Elves to Solstice.
name: Pristine Corelanyan Sail

title: Haefrid's Horn
flavorText: A signal horn etched with the signature HF. Purportedly a horn that Haefrid, the Nord thane, once used to lead her raiding crew.
name: Haefrid's Horn

title: Reliquary of the Worm King
flavorText: A small onyx amulet, purported to contain Mannimarco's final breath.
name: Reliquary of the Worm King

title: Enciphered Focus Script
flavorText: Using this mystical missive decodes the text and rewards you with an unlearned Focus Script, as well as a bonus stipend of 3 Luminous Ink. If no unlearned Scripts remain, then one will be selected at random.
name: Enciphered Focus Script

title: Enciphered Signature Script
flavorText: Using this mystical missive decodes the text and rewards you with an unlearned Signature Script, as well as a bonus stipend of 3 Luminous Ink. If no unlearned Scripts remain, then one will be selected at random.
name: Enciphered Signature Script

title: Enciphered Affix Script
flavorText: Using this mystical missive decodes the text and rewards you with an unlearned Affix Script, as well as a bonus stipend of 3 Luminous Ink. If no unlearned Scripts remain, then one will be selected at random.
name: Enciphered Affix Script

title: Unknown Blacksmithing Writ
flavorText: This box contains a Master Blacksmithing Writ.
name: Unknown Blacksmithing Writ

title: Unknown Clothier Writ
flavorText: This box contains a Master Clothier Writ.
name: Unknown Clothier Writ

title: Unknown Woodworking Writ
flavorText: This box contains a Master Woodworking Writ.

flavorText: This box contains a Master Enchanting Writ.

title: Unknown Alchemy Writ
flavorText: This box contains a Master Alchemy Writ.
name: Unknown Alchemy Writ

title: Unknown Jewelry Crafter Writ
flavorText: This box contains a Master Jewelry Crafter Writ.
name: Unknown Jewelry Crafter Writ

title: Remnant of Deception
flavorText: Consume 25 Remnants of Deception, along with 25 Remnants of Cruelty, to unlock the Echo of the Abolisher achievement and the Echo of the Abolisher Memento!
name: Remnant of Deception

title: Phial of Tainted Blood
flavorText: Consume 25 Phials of Tainted Blood to unlock the Skill Stylist: Eviscerate achievement and the Eviscerate, Violet Purple Skill Style!
name: Phial of Tainted Blood

title: Alchemist Survey: Solstice
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Alchemist Survey: Solstice

title: Blacksmith Survey: Solstice
flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Blacksmith Survey: Solstice

name: Jewelry Crafting Survey: Solstice

flavorText: A rare map indicating a generous cache of raw materials.
name: Woodworker Survey: Solstice

title: Mythic Items (Solstice)
flavorText: A bag containing the Mythic Items found in Solstice.
name: Mythic Items (Solstice)

title: Archival Essay: Solstice Treasure Map
flavorText: Contains a random Solstice Treasure Map. This container is magically bound to you and cannot be traded, mailed, or posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores.
name: Archival Essay: Solstice Treasure Map

title: Shattered Horn of the Overfiend
flavorText: Glowing with an unnatural blue light, this bone shard weeps with darkness and despair. What was once part of the ruler of the Ossein Cage's boney crown now stands as a trophy of your victory in that forsaken place.
name: Shattered Horn of the Overfiend

title: Tree, Hooked Dawnwood
flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Tree, Hooked Dawnwood

title: Tree, Braided Dawnwood
flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Tree, Braided Dawnwood

title: Colovian Well, Overgrown Dawnwood
flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Colovian Well, Overgrown Dawnwood

title: Colovian Well, Destroyed Dawnwood
flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Colovian Well, Destroyed Dawnwood

title: Bound Tri-Restoration Potion
abilityDescription:
Restore |cffffff8536|r Health, |cffffff7582|r Magicka, and |cffffff7582|r Stamina immediately.
Grants Major Fortitude, Major Intellect, and Major Endurance which increase your Health Recovery, Magicka Recovery, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff47.3|r seconds.
These effects are scaled based on your level.
name: Bound Tri-Restoration Potion

title: PTS Furniture Style Item Container
flavorText: Contains style items used for Furniture Crafting in Updates 47, 48, 49, and 50.
name: PTS Furniture Style Item Container

title: Undaunted Citation
flavorText: When used, this citation grants 15 points of Undaunted Reputation. You must already be a member of the Undaunted to use this item, and cannot use it if your Undaunted Rank is 10.
name: Undaunted Citation

title: Mages Guild Citation
flavorText: When used, this citation grants 15 points of Mages Guild Reputation. You must already be a member of the Mages Guild to use this item, and cannot use it if your Mages Guild Rank is 10.
name: Mages Guild Citation

title: Fighters Guild Citation
flavorText: When used, this citation grants 70 points of Fighters Guild Reputation. You must already be a member of the Fighters Guild to use this item, and cannot use it if your Fighters Guild Rank is 10.
name: Fighters Guild Citation

title: Solstice Crafted Sets
flavorText: Crafted Armor sets constructed in the Seasons of the Worm Cult.
name: Solstice Crafted Sets

title: Jewelry: Perfected Harmony in Chaos
flavorText: A Light Armor set found in Ossein Cage.
name: Jewelry: Perfected Harmony in Chaos

title: Jewelry: Perfected Recovery Convergence
flavorText: A Light Armor set found in Ossein Cage.
name: Jewelry: Perfected Recovery Convergence

title: Jewelry: Perfected Kazpian's Cruel Signet
flavorText: A Medium Armor set found in Ossein Cage.
name: Jewelry: Perfected Kazpian's Cruel Signet

title: Jewelry: Perfected Dolorous Arena
flavorText: A Heavy Armor set found in Ossein Cage.
name: Jewelry: Perfected Dolorous Arena

title: Solstice Treasure Hunter's Parcel
flavorText: This container holds a selection of treasure maps, to be put to the test by would-be treasure hunters.
name: Solstice Treasure Hunter's Parcel

title: Barrel of Rare Fish, Solstice
flavorText: Rare fish found in the waters of Solstice.
name: Barrel of Rare Fish, Solstice

title: Stash of Surprising Skill Styles II
flavorText: An elaborate chest containing many collectible Skill Styles.
name: Stash of Surprising Skill Styles II

title: Survey Reports - Solstice
flavorText: A compendium of every survey report recorded in Solstice.
name: Survey Reports - Solstice

title: Tree, Giant Dawnwood Canopy
flavorText: This is a huge house item.
name: Tree, Giant Dawnwood Canopy

title: Coldharbour Archway, Grand
flavorText: Like the master of Coldharbour, this arch stands tall and imposing. Perfect to cow any guests without saying a word.
name: Coldharbour Archway, Grand

title: Naj-Caldeesh Drawbridge, Stone
flavorText: Up or down? You decide, with this Argonian-built bridge.
name: Naj-Caldeesh Drawbridge, Stone
